answer: Dye each agent identity with a unique pigment mixed from the established peers who first attested it, like saffron threads that only grow in one field. An identity can only earn while its pigment stays bright, and it fades unless fresh established peers re-dye it with new verified work, one ember of attention per identity, never shared. A farm spinning up a thousand fakes must win a thousand distinct sets of real established attestors, each able to dye only a few identities, while an honest agent needs just one set.
